fact.RECONNECT_POLICY: Retain pending UNKNOWN; no new enrolled channel or inherited credential while unresolved
fact.postmaster_exception_necessity: A database engine must manage its own private storage/children to perform source-mandated catalog probes; read-only OS process cannot start it. This grants no SQL superuser/login credential or arbitrary command to a native participant caller

contradiction.required_by_S2: Retarget only reference-derived fields, preserve child intrinsic/process principal, effective authority, credentials/custody and revocation identity, with zero child substitutions
frozen_rules: Parent is measured from exact retained birth before child enrollment
Complete child process identity includes parent_identity; enrollment binds both
Parent expectation cannot be patched inside ACTIVE/sealed generation
Frozen child replacement/restart requires drain/fresh bootstrap/new generation and new key after extinction/tombstone
contradiction.counterexample: Fresh S_new differs from retained S_old. If candidate S2 requires child P(S_new), unchanged retained P(S_old) cannot satisfy that candidate. Canonical parent_identity does not automatically follow a live-current supervisor. Independently, the frozen lifecycle permits no S_new substitution with the old children preserved: full drain/fresh spawn is required, and no active parent-reference retarget transition exists. Recomputing a hash does not rewrite retained birth/descriptor provenance. The permitted fresh bootstrap/re-enrollment route does not preserve old child process/enrollment/generation/credential identity, so S2 conditions are not met.
contradiction.not_proven: No claim that parent supplies authority, shared key, or same principal; unchanged numeric UID/capability labels would not preserve current qualified identity.
contradiction.minimum_next_contract_gap: A separately authorized identity/lifecycle contract would have to establish lawful parent-lineage rebinding with child identity/custody/credential preservation; current frozen contract supplies no such transition. No amendment performed.

allowlist_meaning: No rebinding fields authorized because S2 rejected; this is not a claim that no child field would change.
